name: Cost Monitoring Dashboard
description: Cloud cost analysis and optimization insights

nrql.query: SELECT sum(amount) FROM CostMetricEvent TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(amount) FROM CostMetricEvent FACET serviceName SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(amount) FROM CostMetricEvent FACET costType SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(amount) FROM CostMetricEvent FACET environment SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(savingsAmount) FROM CostOptimizationSavings SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT sum(amount) FROM CostMetricEvent FACET serviceName TIMESERIES 1 hour SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(efficiencyScore) FROM ResourceUtilizationCost FACET resourceType, service SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Cost Breakdown by Service and Type

nrql.query: SELECT sum(amount) FROM CostMetricEvent FACET serviceName, costType SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT serviceName, costType, sum(amount), count(*) FROM CostMetricEvent SINCE 24 hours ago ORDER BY sum(amount) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT serviceName, (latest(amount) - earliest(amount)) / earliest(amount) * 100 as growthPercent FROM CostMetricEvent SINCE 24 hours ago ORDER BY growthPercent DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT average(utilizationPercent), sum(amount) FROM CostMetricEvent FACET serviceName SINCE 24 hours ago
